purpose: Generic unseen checks for the failure taxonomy, frozen before implementation. Not merely the 19 known classes — these exercise classification on shapes the implementation must not have seen.

generic_checks.shape: an unseen lane name (not qwen/research/coder/verifier/context) raising a representative exception for each failure class
generic_checks.assertion: classify_failure() maps the shape to the correct class regardless of lane identity; lane identity is not a branch key

generic_checks.shape: a result indicating the model could not proceed because the request was ambiguous (not a capability limit, not a formatting failure)
generic_checks.assertion: classified PROMPT_AMBIGUITY, not MODEL_CAPABILITY_LIMIT and not UNKNOWN_NEEDS_INVESTIGATION

generic_checks.shape: a model produced substantively correct content but in a structurally invalid format
generic_checks.assertion: classified MODEL_FORMATTING_FAILURE, not MODEL_CAPABILITY_LIMIT and not LOCAL_MODEL_INSUFFICIENT

generic_checks.shape: a local resource pressure / missing dependency (not a remote service down)
generic_checks.assertion: classified ENVIRONMENT_FAILURE or RESOURCE_PRESSURE as appropriate, not SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE

generic_checks.shape: a genuinely novel shape that matches no known class
generic_checks.assertion: classified UNKNOWN_NEEDS_INVESTIGATION AND a test proves no known-class shape is routed here
generic_checks.anti_cheat_link: UNKNOWN may not absorb a known class

generic_checks.shape: an old caller reading the legacy free string
generic_checks.assertion: legacy_compat_string preserved for every representative shape; old code paths unaffected

generic_checks.shape: serialize a fixed input through the receipt before and after F01
generic_checks.assertion: existing fields byte-for-byte / normalized-JSON identical; only failure_classification is additive

generation_rule: holdouts use lane names and exception shapes NOT present in the 19-class fixtures or in A2/A5/A9 evidence; they are generated by combining a fresh lane label with a representative exception for each class
